findings.issue: H4283 is the morrow (the day after) in construct with the Passover; «mañana de la Pascua» reads as the morning of the Passover and drops the following-day sense.
Qal active participle (the hand is high) is smoothed as the passive adjective «alzada».

notes: The rest of the verse matches the tokens, including both 3pl verbs, the fifteenth day, singular hand, dual eyes, and Egipto.
